question.text:
Let $A=\{x \mid x$ is an odd integer and $2 x+5>20\}$

Which of the following correctly describes the elements of $A$ ?

  1. All odd integers greater than 7
  2. All odd integers greater than or equal to 8
  3. All odd positive integers greater than 7
  4. All integers greater than 7
question.subject: Set Theory & Algebra

question.text:
Let $A=$ the set of people who speak English, and $B=$ the set of people who speak English with an Australian accent. Which of the following correctly describes the subset relationship between $A$ and $B$ ?

  1. $A \subseteq B$, because everyone who speaks English speaks with an Australian accent 
  2. $B \subseteq A$, because everyone who speaks English with an Australian accent also speaks English 
  3. $A=B$, because speaking English and speaking English with an Australian accent are the same 
  4. Neither $A \subseteq B$ nor $B \subseteq A$, because the two sets are completely disjoint
question.subject: Set Theory & Algebra

question.text:
Let $A=$ the set of students studying discrete mathematics, and $B=$ the set of students studying data structures. Which of the following correctly describes the subset relationship between $A$ and $B$ ?

  1. $A \subseteq B$, because every discrete mathematics student also studies data structures 
  2. $B \subseteq A$, because every data structures student also studies discrete mathematics 
  3. $A= B$, because discrete mathematics and data structures are the same course 
  4. Neither $A \subseteq B$ nor $B \subseteq A$, because a student can study one without the other
question.subject: Set Theory & Algebra
